fixer.summary: I changed Dodge.d20 (dungdra/effects.py:370) to use `ctx.is_save` instead of `ctx.kind == "save"`, so every save effect now goes through the one predicate. Behaviour stays the same: a death save has no ability, so the `ability == "dex"` check still leaves it out. I added a unit test that checks Dodge gives advantage on a Dex save and not on a Con save, a Dex check or a death save. Unit tests pass (332), ruff check and ruff format --check are clean, and dev-gate passes. The ticket names no acceptance tests, so there were none to run with --runxfail.

review.summary: The fix is a one-line change. Dodge.d20 now uses the `ctx.is_save` property (effects.py:42) in place of `ctx.kind == "save"`, and no `kind == "save"` checks are left in dungdra/. Behaviour doesn't change: a death-save Ctx has no ability, so the `ability == "dex"` check still rules it out. The new unit test runs through the real gather path, not a mock. It checks that Dodge gives advantage on a Dex save, and not on a Con save, a Dex check or a death save. It follows the existing Restrained test. The costs.jsonl line is the loop's own bookkeeping. Nothing in the change goes beyond the ticket.
